description: Header file defining the MPSStream class and related components for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) stream management in the at::mps namespace, including method declarations, class definitions, and external dependencies.

classes.name: MPSStream
classes.description: Class managing Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) command streams, providing methods for command buffer management, synchronization, and execution.

classes.name: MPSStreamImpl
classes.description: Singleton class providing access to a single instance of MPSStream.

methods.name: commandBuffer
methods.description: Returns the current MPS command buffer.

methods.name: endKernelCoalescing
methods.description: Ends kernel coalescing for the stream.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the stream based on the specified SyncType.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills a buffer with a specified value.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data between buffers with optional profiling.

methods.name: copy_and_sync
methods.description: Copies data between buffers and performs synchronization.

methods.name: executeMPSGraph
methods.description: Executes an MPS graph with given inputs and outputs.

methods.name: addCompletedHandler
methods.description: Adds a completion handler to the command buffer.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the MTLDevice associated with the stream.

methods.name: getCurrentMPSStream
methods.description: Returns the current MPS stream instance.

methods.name: getDefaultMPSStream
methods.description: Returns the default MPS stream instance.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MPSStream.
